idle: (He checks his coat pocket.) Still there. Good. Good.
Ama. A-ma. Okay. I can say her name. That's a start.
good_ice: Good ice. Nobody falls. Unless they want to. I don't want to. Not yet.
bad_ice: If I kneel on that I'm going to slide into the boards. Romantically, maybe.
wet_ice: You can't kneel on wet ice. My knees will be wet. In the photos.
cold: My hands are cold. My hands are always cold. Nerves.
hungry: I cook all week. I'm not hungry. I'm never hungry. I'm nervous.
long_line: A line. More time to rehearse.
greet_owner: Hey! Hi. It's still in my pocket.
Oh, hey. Don't tell Ama anything.
leaving_happy: Great skate. Not tonight. But soon.
leaving_angry: Maybe I'll propose at the Slapshot instead. No. No. Here.

public_skate: That's our song. No, it isn't. Okay.
special: Couples skate! Is this the night? It's not the night.

first.say: Hi! Devon. Devon Marsh. I cook at the Slapshot. I met my girlfriend here, at Saturday public skate. She skated into me and apologised to the boards. (He checks his coat pocket.)

first_pocket.say: Nothing! A ring. Nothing. Don't tell Ama. I've told everyone except Ama. You're number forty-one.

first_sweet.say: Right? She said 'sorry' to the boards, then to me, then to the boards again. I've been in love since the second sorry.

options.text: I'm sorry, Devon. That's not the night you wanted.
I'll make it right for the big night.

say: (He's holding Ama's hand and checking his pocket with the other.) Not now. Not now. Hi.
Is this our song? It's not our song. Okay.

engaged.say: She said YES! During the slowest song ever played on a Casio! I fell over after. She fell over too. We're getting married!

options.text: Want to practise what you'll say?
Who's helping with the big night?
What's the rink like for a date?

job.say: Line cook. Wings, mostly. I can do forty wings at once without looking. I can't say four words to Ama without looking at my shoes.

ama.say: She laughs at the falls. Mine and hers. She skates like she's late for something wonderful. And she always says sorry to things that can't hear.

rehearse.say: Okay. Okay. (He kneels.) Ama, from the moment you hit the boards, I knew... no. From the moment you hit me... no. Hit is bad. Is hit bad?

options.text: Keep it simple. Just say what you feel.

rehearse_simple.say: Simple. Okay. 'Ama. Will you.' And then the rest. (He stands up. He looks taller.) Yeah. Yeah, I can do that.

rehearse_hit.say: 'From the moment you collided with me.' Better? It's worse. It sounds like an insurance claim.

gossip.say: Doreen's going to play our song on the Casio, if I ask nicely. And Dylan can do the lights, as long as I don't go near breaker 14. Everyone says that. What's on breaker 14?

rink.say: It's where we met. It's perfect. Okay, the lights are either on or off. A dimmer would be perfect. Romantic lighting.

options.text: I'll see what I can do.

rink_better.say: It's beautiful. It was always beautiful to me, but now it's beautiful to Ama's mum, too. That matters.
